column1: # Optic Bokeh v2.3 string table: kind<TAB>English (exact string used in the code)<TAB>Japanese.
# kind: name = param / group / checkbox name (<= 31 bytes in the host code page), popup = '|'-separated
# popup items (same item count as English, each item <= 31 bytes), label = picker labels / UI text
# (UTF-16 in Drawbot, no byte limit), msg = About / error text (return_msg, <= 255 bytes).
# Optional 4th column (items only): the popup text when the Japanese text has a Shift_JIS byte 0x7C ('|',
# e.g. the trail byte of ポ) that would split the popup item; the picker labels (UTF-16) keep the 3rd column.
# Optional 5th column: the text for UTF-8 host strings when the 3rd column is longer than the 31-byte SDK
# limit in UTF-8 (3 bytes per kana / kanji). UTF-8 has no "|" trail-byte problem, so it ignores the 4th column.
# The host encoding is chosen by OB_HOST_STRING_ENCODING (plugin\OpticBokehConfig.h): English only / CP932 / UTF-8.
# Generated into ob_strings_table.inc by tools\gen_strings.py (ASCII-escaped). Review copy: docs\param_names_ja.md
